algorithm: {This algorithm is a random search with adaptive sampling density around promising regions, inspired by efficient global optimization techniques.}
{A Simple Random Search algorithm with adaptive sampling that focuses on exploring the most promising regions of the search space by adjusting the step size and direction based on past performance.}
{**The proposed algorithm is a modified version of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) that integrates a custom clipping mechanism for bounded optimization problems.**}
